issue.title: test_prompt_tab_focus_steal fails under xdist with FrontmatterPanel.on_mount NoMatches
issue.description: Phase sase-1fu.1 note #1 (2026-10-03): the guarded check's scoped suite failed tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_tab_focus_steal.py, and the same file passed alone (5 passed). Phase sase-1fu.4 note #1 (2026-10-04): guarded check a02d6119e8519df3ad9af681b421ea69 had 6,348 passed, 5 failed, and 5 errors, all five cases in that file, each with a FrontmatterPanel.on_mount NoMatches(#frontmatter-raw) teardown error. The same 5 failed / 5 errors reproduced with `pytest -n 4 --dist=worksteal -q tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_tab_focus_steal.py` on commit 2307212bcd (18.95s). sase-1fu did not edit frontmatter_panel.py. This land agent did not re-run the file. The serial pass and the xdist failure are the two phase notes, so this is a flake rather than a streaming defect. Closed task sase-pe fixed a different node (test_enter_loads_raw_definition_and_binds_source) with the same missing-widget symptom. Open epic sase-j7 tracks the parallel-lane flake class but does not name this node.
